main_topics.reason: The user opened with pain returning and said it is worst during the pill break, which prompted the discussion.
The user asked for the full range of alternatives, explored their drawbacks, and asked what to try first.
The user asked whether disease found on the ovary and near the bowel changes which treatments may work.
The user described being discharged to the GP after surgery and discussed asking for specialist re-referral.
The user asked whether there were alternatives to hormones and then asked specifically about pelvic floor physiotherapy.
The user asked whether physiotherapy would require private care, and the assistant discussed NHS referral and availability.
The user said they were tired of treatments always being about hormones, though they did not return to this feeling later.

output.summary: The user described endometriosis pain returning on the combined pill, especially during the break week, and asked about hormonal and nonhormonal options, including whether disease near the bowel and on the ovary affects treatment choices. They also discussed seeking specialist follow-up and access to pelvic floor physiotherapy; by the end, they had a list of options to raise with the GP and said they felt less stuck.
